basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old card game aficionado living in Toronto, Canada. By day, I work as a software developer, but my evenings are often spent cycling or exploring new music genres. I'm particularly interested in indie and electronic music. While I consider myself somewhat of an introvert, I enjoy engaging with online communities. I'm currently single and open to new relationships. My online activity usually peaks in the late evenings after work, around 8-11 PM EST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which has fueled my passion for technology and programming. Over the years, I've self-taught myself various card games, with euchre being my favorite. My interest in music has also led me to explore sound design and music production in my free time.
